'''2007 Yavin 4 Regionals Tim Simon DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tim Simon]] at [[2007 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' 70 Cards
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
